Briefly stated, the aforementioned complaint has been filed against the petitioners and the co accused on the allegations that by taking advantage of the fact that the mutation in respect of exchange of some land by the petitioners in favour of the complainant had not been entered and sanctioned in the revenue record, they sold the said land to the co-accused accused, thereby committing the offense of cheating forgery and use of forged 1 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:105452 CRM-M-39834 39834-2024 (O&M) -2 2- documents.

Apprehending their arrest they moved an application for grant nt of anticipatory bail, which has been dismissed by the Court ourt of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Sirsa, vide order dated 08.08.2024.
3. It is argued by learned counsel for the petitioners etitioners that they are ready to face the trial.
Their custodial interrog interrogation ation is not required.
They do not have any criminal antecedents.
Therefore it is urged that the petition deserves to be allowed.
4. Since it is a private complaint case, learned State counsel has chosen not to address any argument.
However, learned couns counsel el for the complainant has opposed the prayer of the petitioners.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the petitioners and perused the record.
6. The petitioners have been summoned as accused in a private complaint case.
Neither their custodial interroga interrogation tion is required nor any recovery is to be affected affected from them.

The subject offen offences es are triable by Magistrate.
agistrate.
No purpose would be served by detaining them in custody.
They are ready to join the proceedings before the learned trial court.
The main purpose for issuance of warrants is to secure the presence of the accused which the petitioners in this case are ready to ensure if extended benefit of anticipatory bail.
As such, in the considered opinion of this C Court, ourt, it is a fit case to extend benefit of anticipatory anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly Accordingly, the petition is allowed and the petitioners are ordered to be admitted to bail by 2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:105452 CRM-M-39834 39834-2024 (O&M) -3 3- learned trial Court, subject to their surrendering before it on or before the date fixed 04.09.2024 and furnishing bondss to its satisfaction.
